name: Stubborn Pikecollar
description: Press the shoulder against the neighbour's and lock the braced pike, qi stiffening the line against a push.

name: Wild Levelhold
description: Jab the pike a hand's breadth forward from the braced stance without breaking the line.

name: Fleet Couchout
description: Step sideways into a gap that opens in the line, bringing the pike level beside the next man.

name: Shaftlinen
description: Feel through the neighbouring shaft which part of the line is about to take the press.

name: Lurching Bristle
description: Drive qi into the pike as the line takes the press, so the point pierces armour at the contact.

name: Stalwart Pikehead
description: Let the shaft flex slightly in the hands while qi spreads the press along the line, easing the load.

name: Pikebarrier
description: Set the point at the height of a horse's breast and hold it there as the animal comes on.

name: Rude Brace
description: Thrust upward past the saddle's edge into the rider's belly as the horse is halted.

name: Gripping Steelcap
description: Knock the rider's bridle arm aside with the shaft to throw the horse's line off.

name: Lithe Footspike
description: Step to the stirrup side of a passing horse, away from the rider's lance hand.

name: Unmoving Pikeshaft
description: Catch an enemy lance on the pike shaft and slide it wide past the shoulder.

name: Braceglide
description: Shuffle back as a stricken horse falls so its heavy body does not crush the brace.

name: Stalwart Pikebands
description: Wedge the butt in the ground and fill the shaft with qi to take the full shock of a galloping horse.

name: Ashstaff Thwack
description: Drop the point and drive it into the horse's foreleg as it passes, qi hardening the tip.

name: Veering Mastlength
description: Trail the point near the ground while advancing so the foe cannot judge the pike's reach.

name: Shaftflog
description: Snap the trailing pike up to level in one motion, the point rising into the foe's guard.

name: Shaftcurl
description: Slide the hands up the shaft as the foe closes, preparing a short stab with the choked grip.

name: Shaftswerve
description: Retreat while the butt drags a line in the ground, keeping the point toward the foe.

name: Pikeshoe Barrier
description: Sweep the trailing shaft upward across the body to knock a blade away.

name: Pikeslap
description: Fire three quick short stabs with the choked grip, each carrying a thread of qi.

name: Lassoing Press
description: Hide the point behind the leg, then bring it up under the guard with a surge of qi.

name: Draught Steelcap
description: Poke the point through the gap between two neighbouring pikes into a foe pressing the hedge.

name: Discord Levelhold
description: Beat an enemy pike aside where it crosses the hedge, clearing the front of your own point.

name: Sprout Pikeshaft
description: Pass qi down the shaft to the pike behind, strengthening its thrust over your shoulder.

name: Veering Brace
description: Shuffle sideways to close a gap in the hedge before a foe can slip into it.

name: Hum Longpole
description: Cross shafts with a neighbour to make a lattice that turns a blow to either side.

name: Stern Pikehead
description: Thrust over the front man's shoulder from the second rank, reaching a foe he cannot touch.

name: Stamp Present
description: Pin an enemy shaft between two of your own pikes so the foe cannot withdraw it.

name: Pressscorer
description: Sweep the pike low across the hedge front, qi widening the cut to rake several attackers' legs.

name: Sprig Mastlength
description: Let qi bind the crossed shafts of the hedge into a lattice that holds against a heavy push.

name: Shaftthwack
description: Thrust and withdraw so the next pike thrusts through the same gap, qi timing both as one blow.

name: Rooted Ashstaff
description: Choke the pike to a short length when the crowd presses and the long shaft cannot swing.

name: Pikeshoe Thwack
description: Drive the shortened pike with elbows tucked, stabbing a foe pressed chest to chest.

name: Press Hammerfall
description: Swing the iron butt into the face of a foe who closes inside the point.

name: Prowling Pikebands
description: Turn the shoulders edge-on to slip between two pressing bodies, holding the shortened pike close.

name: Burdening Couchout
description: Wedge the shaft crosswise against a foe's chest and shove, making a pace of room.

name: Harsh Longpole
description: Stab under the raised arm of a foe pressing hard, the point rising into the ribs.

name: Hungry Footspike
description: Drive the shortened pike with a measured burst of qi, piercing deep without a long wind-up.

name: Shaftcordial
description: Read through the shaft the weight of the pressing bodies to know which foe is about to surge.

name: Shaftprop
description: Spin the shortened pike round the body with qi, throwing back foes pressing in from all sides.

name: Honedbrace
description: Feed qi down each stride so the thrust at the end of the step lands hard.

name: Clay Steelcap
description: Advance quickly with the pike carried level so the point never dips or wavers.

name: Hum Pikecollar
description: Step back and draw the pike across with the returning qi, turning aside a pursuing thrust.

name: Pikebandage
description: Sense the line's rhythm through the ground and hold a firm pace in time with the file.

name: Slinking Present
description: Surge two strides on a pulse of qi with the pike levelled, closing a gap before the foe reacts.

name: Honedshaft
description: Drive each footfall's force up through the legs and shaft into one piercing thrust.

name: Dire Bristle
description: Lower the point and stab into the thigh of an advancing foe before he closes.

name: Dire Ashstaff
description: Flip the pike and drive the iron butt upward under the chin of a close foe.

name: Rigid Footspike
description: Drop the point across the body so the shaft slants down and turns a high cut aside.

name: Pikebuckle
description: Raise the butt end in front of the face to shield against a thrown strike or low blade.

name: Clutching Levelhold
description: Dip the levelled pike suddenly toward the ground, drawing the foe's eyes and guard downward.

name: Masthurdle
description: Advance with the point held low and the body crouched, hiding the line of the thrust.

name: Rude Present
description: Drop the point and drive it upward under a guard, qi hardening the head against mail.

name: Pikeswat
description: Swing the iron butt up and over with qi behind it, hammering a helmeted head.

name: Brawn Bristle
description: Beat the incoming point aside with your own shaft, then stab through the opening it leaves.

name: Clay Longpole
description: Set the rear foot hard and let the braced shaft take a thrust before answering.

name: Clay Press
description: Step inside the foe's thrust and slip past the point while keeping your own levelled.

name: Humpress
description: Twist your shaft round the meeting pike and wrench it off its line.

name: Guarding Pikeshaft
description: Draw the pike back from the brace, sweeping aside the counter as the shaft returns.

name: Fierce Pikebands
description: Meet an incoming thrust with your own, qi extending your point a finger beyond his.

name: Brass Pikecollar
description: Hold the rear-foot brace with qi while the shaft takes the foe's thrust, then surge it back.
